places.source: place=* nodes and area label points
places.min_zoom: country 0, state/province 3, city 4, town 7, village 9, suburb 11, hamlet/neighbourhood/locality 13

landcover.source: natural=* areas (natural classes 0 or 8), landuse=* areas (8), leisure parks/pitches/... (8)

transport.source: highway=* lines (not area=yes), railway=* lines except platform/station

buildings.source: building=* closed ways and multipolygon relations

pois.source: all values of amenity, shop, tourism, leisure, office, healthcare, craft, historic, emergency, public_transport

exclusions_reported: Sea/ocean area fill: OSM coastline lines are rendered as lines; coastline-to-polygon processing and external water polygons are not part of phase 1.
highway areas (area=yes), aeroway, aerialway, power, barrier, route relations and other uncatalogued tagged objects: kept in render.uncatalogued for inspection, not rendered.
Terrain and satellite imagery are outside phase 1.
